changelog: Fix Kaggle LoRA training data loss: kaggle kernels push only uploads the code file named in kernel-metadata.json, so the sibling dataset_payload.py and dataset.jsonl never reached the container and each run silently trained on six seed samples. The dataset is now embedded directly inside train_unsloth_lora.py by scripts/bundle_dataset.py, and the loader resolves it from there first, so a real 8600-row run trains with hundreds of steps instead of one. The run also reports why Kaggle UserSecrets could not be read, instead of silently continuing without them. Previous release: added a sys.path fix for importing dataset_payload from /kaggle/src/.
